notes:

Expected: the Test Case says the email arrives in Mailpit in the chosen language (ADR 0009 invitation). Actual: no mail is sent; the api answers 201 with the one-time token and its code comment says email delivery comes later; the person can only accept with that token. Screenshot: evidence/PAR-02-1-saeed-members.jpg (Member invited then active).
The new Member uat.par02.339524@tmc.demo.rabaed.test stays (active, on no Project). The password was made up at run time and is not kept.
